{{Top|leg}}
'''''Imperial Spacefaring Regulations''''' was guidelines put forth by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Space Ministry]] to govern space travel. Updates were provided by the Ministry in the ''[[Spacers' Information Manual]]'', which was provided upon renewing one's flight certification.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
